text.style: font-family: Roboto-Bold, QJXSDX+Roboto-Bold; font-size: 35px; font-weight: 700; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: Full Stop (.)

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: This is placed at the end of a sentence

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: when the sentence is completely finished.

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: It indicates that the thought or statement

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: is complete.

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Bold, QJXSDX+Roboto-Bold; font-size: 35px; font-weight: 700; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: Exclamation Mark (!)

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: This is used to express emotions like

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: happiness, sadness, surprise, anger, etc.

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Bold, QJXSDX+Roboto-Bold; font-size: 35px; font-weight: 700; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: Apostrophe (')

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: This tiny mark has two jobs. It shows that

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: something belongs to someone (Ria's book).

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: It also joins two words by removing some

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: letters (don't = do not).

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Bold, QJXSDX+Roboto-Bold; font-size: 35px; font-weight: 700; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: Question Mark (?)

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: When a question is asked, this mark is placed

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: at the end of the sentence. It shows that the

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: sentence is in the form of a question.

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Bold, QJXSDX+Roboto-Bold; font-size: 35px; font-weight: 700; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: Comma (,)

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: This is used to pause briefly in the middle of a

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: sentence. It is used to separate different parts

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: of a sentence or to make a list.

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Bold, QJXSDX+Roboto-Bold; font-size: 35px; font-weight: 700; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: Quotation Marks (“ “)

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: This is used to write someone's words exactly

text.style: font-family: Roboto-Regular, BCMGBB+Roboto-Regular; font-size: 35px; isolation: isolate;
text.tspan: as spoken.
